lenses.brief: V2, THE PUNK IN MOTION AT 1 M (rubric J8-J12). Record C3, C4, C5, C11, C12 and C13 on the reviewed commit; cut 12 fps sheets and full-resolution stills of every strike, reaction and seam (tools/look_sheets.sh), and look at them beside the concept and beside the M3 before pack (captures/m4_before/c3, c4, c5, c11). Score J8 (deformation: shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips and knees keep their volume through the guard, jab, cross, shove, strafe and walk, flinch, stagger, knockdown and get-up; no candy-wrap, collapse or visible self-intersection; say whether the waist hem's 8.4 cm stretch in the cross's twist can be seen at 1 m), J9 (life: the idle breathes, no pops at loop seams or between clips, the feet plant walking and circling), J10 (contact: the fist reaches the hit, the flash lands on the struck spot, staggers follow the ragdoll exactly with no gap or pop at the write-back, the KO slump and blink-off read), J11 (damage looks: clean, bruised and bloodied read at 1 m and stay stuck to the moving body; marks-off on the lens) and J12 (wind-ups read at 1 m and at 2.5 m, as M3's readability needs; record C14 for the long take if it helps). Also check the hold (C11): the held Punk never clips the lens, the knees land on him, the throw reads.

V3, THE PLAYER'S OWN ARMS AND LEGS (rubric J14, critical), the most-seen asset in the game. Record 'Look: my arms and legs', 'Look: my knockdown' (also with CAPTURE_ARGS="--tune=fp_knockdown_hide_torso=1"), 'Look: tune own hull', C8 and C11 on the reviewed commit; take full-resolution stills of the idle, look-down 45 and 65 degrees, jab, cross, hook, uppercut, front kick, spin kick, block guard, hold and knee, the haymaker charge, the knockdown and the KO view, and look at them beside assets/source/concepts/hero_c_martial.jpg (sleeveless gi top, bare upper arms, wrapped forearms, dark fingerless-glove plates with bare fingers, wrapped ankles, black slip-ons with cream soles; 'no mix and match: the whole hero is concept C') and beside the fix round's before/after stills. Score J14: the wraps, gloves, forearms, trousers and shoes are the most detailed things on screen at 0.3-0.6 m; no hollow cut, seam, crack or pop at the first-person split (Body, Body__fp_hidden, Body__fp_torso; the upper arm's dome and the belly's dome), nothing clips the lens, the outlines aren't heavy. Judge, don't just accept, call 19 (the near upper arm still fills about a quarter of the view in the jab, as M3's capsule does) and the girth clamp (call 21). Check the KO view shows the whole lying body, the hidden upper body casts the shadows the player sees, and the hero art plays well with the four feel toggles at their defaults. Also check the hero stays in data files (player_art.tres names the GLB) so the future hero menu needs no code change: flag anything Hero-C-specific in code.

V4, ONE LOOK (rubric J13; second opinions on J4 and J5 across the whole scene). Score J13: the placeholders (Kicker, Thug, Bruiser, dummies, pipe), the street and the VFX (ink weight, Ben-Day dots, lettering) read as one style with the Punk and the hero; the edges, the LUT and halftone don't muddy it; red only for blood, the warning and finisher accents (A3). Judge the lead's look calls from the stills: the linear tonemapper (call 13; look_tonemap=1 restores filmic), the camera-fixed fill light (call 14), placeholder outlines on (call 5), 4x MSAA (call 4). Report L1, L2, L3 and L5 from the probe and say whether L1's 10 m sides and L2's front-lit single band are visible flaws or metric artefacts, from the stills.
